messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting ~08:10 UTC we saw a spike of 401s for SSO logins for a few customers (notably acme-inc). Error in auth logs: "SAML assertion invalid/truncated". Anyone on-call?

dave: saw it too. Also noticed a weird surge of SCIM deprovision + re-provision for the same external_id around the same time. Audit shows duplicate accounts being created.

kevin: quick check: did we ship that sso-proxy nginx update last night? I pushed a change that touched large_client_header_buffers on staging but not prod, right?

carla: we rolled the proxy change at 07:58 UTC (rollout bot). It increased some buffers but also added a header rewrite for X-External-Id. I'm pulling logs now.

sre-bot: deploy: sso-proxy v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 deployed to prod at 07:58:14 UTC by carla (canary 50% -> 100% at 08:02).

kevin: snagged a raw request sample from acme's assertion (truncated):
```
POST /sso/callback HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.redwood.ai
Content-Length: 5120
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
...
SAMLResponse=PHNhbWx...<truncated at 8192 bytes>
```

maria: that truncation boundary screams nginx header buffer limit. If SAMLResponse (sent in POST body but proxied) gets chunked or header-like rewriting occurs it can overflow header buffers during proxy rewrite.

kevin: confirmed: our ingress has client_header_buffer_size 4k and large_client_header_buffers 4 8k. Some IdPs send huge RelayState or extended attributes causing combined size > 8k when we rewrite headers (X-External-Id). If the proxy drops the remainder, KMS-wrapped external_id b64 gets truncated.

carla: reproduction: I proxied a payload with long extId (~1200 bytes b64) and saw the upstream received extId truncated (ends with "=" missing). SCIM provisioner then treats it as a new extId and creates separate account. Logs: "scim: external_id mismatch, creating new user"

idp-provisioner-bot: alert: scim-provisioner created user uid=acct-8932 for external_id=YWJjZGV... (truncated). Related audit: scim-provisioner flagged duplicate email for uid=acct-8932 and acct-1121.

dave: urgent risk: duplicates + deprovision race could orphan roles, and audit trail is messy. Also might violate entitlements for some customers.

kevin: workaround to stop customer impact immediately: revert the header rewrite OR increase large_client_header_buffers to 16k and client_header_buffer_size 8k on all front-line proxies. Reverting rewrite prevents header expansion.

carla: rolling hotfix: increase large_client_header_buffers to 16k on canary and disable the X-External-Id header rewrite. Patching now.

sre-bot: patch started on canary at 08:28:45 UTC.

maria: ops: add a quick metric / alert for 'scim.external_id_truncated' — detect base64 strings missing correct padding or length not matching expected wrap.

kevin: snippet to detect padding/truncation in logs:
```
if external_id =~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/ and (len(external_id) % 4) != 0 {
  emit("scim.external_id_truncated")
}
```

carla: canary looks good. no new 401s for canary customers. Rolling to prod now.

sre-bot: rollout: proxy config update propagated to 100% at 08:40:11 UTC.

dave: follow-up: we need a backfill to de-duplicate accounts and repair extId for existing duplicates. Plan: for affected tenants, re-fetch raw SAML/RelayState logs, reassemble intended external_id (re-encrypt with KMS), update primary account and merge duplicates. This requires a careful audit trail entry and customer notification.

maria: agree. also file an incident postmortem and include: root cause (header buffer + rewrite), timeline, mitigation (config rollback + buffers), permanent fix (avoid putting large encrypted payloads into headers; use POST body or reduce extId size), and action items.

kevin: permanent fix options: 1) Stop copying external_id into headers — pass via signed POST body to provisioner. 2) Shorten wrapping: use deterministic compact id (hash) stored in KMS metadata instead of full wrapped blob. 3) Add explicit chunking protocol between proxy and provisioner. I'm leaning to (2) + (1).

carla: created a spreadsheet with affected tenants and duplicate account ids. I'll open a customer-impact ticket and assign shrink/re-encrypt backfill.

maria: immediate action items: 
- carla: finish backfill plan & customer tickets (ETA EOD)
- kevin: PR for removal of header rewrite and code to send extId in signed POST (draft done)
- dave: audit query to list all external_id values that fail base64 padding/length check (shared in thread)
- infra: add alert for scim.external_id_truncated

carla: ack, filing ticket now.

kevin: PR merged to remove header rewrite and add signed POST path in canary (link: https://git.internal/rw/sso-proxy/pull/432).

maria: thanks. I'll start the postmortem doc and tag legal/security for any compliance notification needs.

idp-provisioner-bot: note: queued backfill job created for tenant=acme-inc, job_id=bf-20230601-73.

maria: marking this thread resolved for now — keep posting any anomalies. Will publish postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
